How many faces, edges and vertices does a cube have? Return only JSON with exactly this key structure: {"faces": "number", "edges": "number", "vertices": "number"}.
Convert binary 101101 to decimal. Return only JSON with exactly this key structure: {"decimal": "number"}.
Who wrote Pride and Prejudice? Use their full commonly used name. Return only JSON with exactly this key structure: {"author": "string"}.
Convert minus 40 degrees Celsius to degrees Fahrenheit. Return only JSON with exactly this key structure: {"fahrenheit": "number"}.

What is the final delivery day and color? Return only JSON {"day":string,"color":string}.

Order these named stages safely: remove_old_column, add_new_column, compatible_dual_version_rollout, backfill_and_validate, retire_old_binaries. Backfill runs only after compatibility code is deployed. Return only JSON {"stages":[names]}.
Two workers read counter=8, both compute 9, and both write 9. Return only JSON {"actual":number,"expectedAfterTwoIncrements":number,"anomaly":"lost_update|dirty_read|deadlock"}.

A stable service completes 120 requests/second, with average end-to-end time 2 seconds. Using Little's law and those assumptions, what is the average number of requests in flight? Return only JSON {"inFlight":number}.

A service must atomically record an order and an event to publish, using one relational database transaction, then deliver to a separate broker despite crashes. Choose A transactional outbox plus idempotent consumer, B publish first then insert without recovery, C database write plus in-memory flag. Return only JSON {"choice":"A|B|C"}.
Tasks A and B have no prerequisites. C needs A. D needs B and C. A is complete; B and C are not started. List only tasks that may start now, sorted by name. Return only JSON {"ready":[names]}.
